genesis-block-wallet-puzzle: SOLVED by Schum-io on 2026-10-17, folder moved to 4-solved

Both cosigners come from one 12-word mnemonic whose entropy is the first 128 bits of
sha256 of the coinbase text's hex (cut -b 263-400 of the raw block hex), passphrase
Satoshi Nakamoto, PBKDF2 at 181505 (18:15:05) and 200913 (2009/1/3) rounds, both keys at
m/48'/0'/1231006505'/2'/0/0. The escrow (946,540 sats, 117 outputs) was swept in block
971803, 935,266 sats to the solver; the author acknowledged the solve on chain.

- README: SOLVED badge, the post-September author answers, mechanism, Solution section
- puzzle.json: tier/status solved, prize and address state, solutions[], leads closed
- clues/author-posts.md and data/on-chain-dialogue.json: 95 new transactions (119 total)
- analysis/tested.md and leads.md: closed by the solve, all negatives were at 2048 rounds
- tools/verify_solution.py: rebuilds both keys from data/genesis-block.hex, oracle MATCH AB
- puzzles.json and the generated README tables regenerated
